lastCompletedStory.title: Route review-report readers in host.ts and review.ts through parseReviewReport

nextStoryContext: host.ts's makeReadReviewReport now delegates entirely to the shared report-parse.ts parser: it reads the raw file text and returns parseReviewReport(raw) inside the existing try/catch (null-on-error contract unchanged). The old inline `typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) && typeof parsed.verdict === 'string'` shape guard is gone; parseReviewReport now also validates findings[] entries (severity+text required strings, optional file/line type-checked) and fail-closes the WHOLE report to null if any entry is malformed, which the old inline guard never did (it only checked `verdict`). review.ts required ZERO changes: its dispatch loop already sourced verdictKind/findingsCount/fileFindings exclusively from the injected readReviewReport() return value (typed ReviewReport | null) and already falls back to the <review>-tag path (parseReviewVerdict over capture-pane) whenever that dep returns null, whether the file is missing OR now-more-strictly malformed. This completes the report-parse.ts wiring arc across all known consumers: host.ts's two readers (worker-report via US-002, review-report via this story) + loop.ts's round-trip consumer (US-002) + result.ts (US-003) all now share the one report-parse.ts contract. If a future story adds a fifth reader of either report shape, route it through parseWorkerReport/parseReviewReport directly (raw text) or via the JSON.stringify round-trip (already-typed-but-not-runtime-guaranteed object), per the patterns already documented for US-002/US-003.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal refactor routing host.ts's review-report reader onto the already-validated (US-001) shared report-parse.ts parser; no external library surface touched.
